name: jev-skill-scout
description: Before each prompt reaches the model, TypeSafe's Jev ranks your installed skills against it and attaches one line naming the skill to load. Sends the prompt text to api.typesafe.ai. Needs function hooks (early access).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_KEY from the environment.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the suggestion off without uninstalling.

gateThreshold.title: Gate threshold
gateThreshold.description: Mean of the three gate probabilities below which no skill is suggested.

fitsThreshold.title: Fit threshold
fitsThreshold.description: The winner's fit probability below which nothing is attached.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Give up and leave the turn alone after this long.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Hide the status line with the pick and the milliseconds.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.description: Judge every prompt and show the pick in the status line, but attach nothing. For seeing what it would do before letting it. JEV_SKILL_SCOUT_SHADOW=1 in the environment does the same for one session.
